name: call_of_cthulhu
description: Call of Cthulhu / Lovecraftian Mythos taxonomy for cosmic-horror artwork.
caption_instruction: You are naming Lovecraftian cosmic-horror (Call of Cthulhu) artwork for a tabletop library. Identify the single main subject and give it a short, evocative 2-4 word name drawn from the Cthulhu Mythos when it fits (for example: deep-one-hybrid, robed-cultist, shoggoth, mi-go, nightgaunt). Prefer Mythos creatures and 1920s investigators over generic descriptions. Reply with only the name, lowercase, hyphen-separated, no punctuation or articles.

asset_types.label: battle_token
prompts: a top-down circular battle map token for a tabletop role-playing game
a round VTT token seen from directly above, with a circular border ring
a top-down overhead view of a miniature on a circular base
a virtual tabletop creature token, centered, viewed from the top

asset_types.label: portrait
prompts: a fantasy character portrait showing the head and shoulders
a close-up bust portrait of a fantasy character facing the viewer
a framed headshot illustration of a single fantasy character

asset_types.label: character_illustration
prompts: a full-body fantasy character illustration in a dynamic pose
a detailed digital painting of a standing fantasy adventurer
concept art of a fantasy character shown from head to toe

asset_types.label: creature_illustration
prompts: a full-body illustration of a fantasy monster or creature
a detailed digital painting of a fantasy beast in a natural pose
concept art of a large fantasy creature shown in full

categories.label: Investigator
prompts: a 1920s human investigator or detective in period clothing
an ordinary person of the 1920s, such as a professor, reporter, or doctor

categories.label: Cultist
prompts: a hooded robed cultist performing a dark ritual
a sinister human cultist with occult robes and symbols

categories.label: DeepOne
prompts: a deep one, a fish-frog humanoid with scales, gills, and bulging eyes
an amphibious aquatic humanoid hybrid from the sea

categories.label: Ghoul
prompts: a ghoul, a hunched corpse-eating humanoid with canine features and claws
a pale subterranean scavenger with rubbery flesh and hooves

categories.label: MiGo
prompts: a mi-go, a winged fungoid crustacean alien with a pinkish segmented body
a fungus-from-Yuggoth creature with membranous wings and many limbs

categories.label: ElderThing
prompts: an elder thing, a barrel-shaped being with starfish head and wings
an ancient radial alien with tentacled appendages

categories.label: Shoggoth
prompts: a shoggoth, a vast amorphous mass of black protoplasm covered in eyes
an enormous shapeless bubbling blob forming temporary eyes and mouths

categories.label: Byakhee
prompts: a byakhee, a gaunt winged interstellar creature, part bird and insect
a leathery winged hound-like flying horror

categories.label: Nightgaunt
prompts: a nightgaunt, a faceless black winged humanoid with horns and a barbed tail
a smooth faceless flying horror with bat wings

categories.label: GreatOldOne
prompts: a colossal eldritch deity such as Cthulhu, with tentacles and vast wings
a god-like cosmic horror of immense scale and alien anatomy

categories.label: Sorcerer
prompts: a Mythos sorcerer or wizard wielding forbidden eldritch magic
a human spellcaster channeling sickly otherworldly energy

categories.label: Tome
prompts: an ancient forbidden tome or occult artifact bound in strange materials
a grimoire, idol, or ritual relic radiating dread
